packs.title: Four City Outings
packs.promise: Explore museums, architecture and the Ping through four separate outings.

q.s: Collect a small museum reading list.
st: Visit the admitted exhibition route and choose three objects or interpretation displays with different materials or media.
For each, note the material or medium, one visible feature and the place or use identified by its label. Do not handle objects.
After leaving sensitive rooms, turn those three observations into a short list.

q.s: Make an architectural response after a museum visit.
st: Observe two different available house exteriors on the admitted museum route. Compare roof form, raised floor or the way an open space connects to an enclosed one.
The Mae Taeng house is described as twin-gabled and raised; compare it with another available house without entering a closed room.
After leaving the houses, make two small sketches or four original written lines: two lines for each form, joined by one feature they share.

q.s: Create from an admitted rotating exhibition.
st: Visit the admitted current main exhibition and choose one work with a visible shape or arrangement that interests you.
Make a brief personal observation of its shape and spacing. Do not copy the artwork or treat the artist’s statement as your own words.
After leaving the exhibition room, make an original four-line description or a simple new sketch that changes the arrangement. Add one sentence explaining your choice.

packs.title: Two Old City Outings
packs.promise: Connect Old City collections, temple details, a park and the east gate.

q.s: Collect craft details inside the Folklife Centre.
st: Choose one available sculpture detail, one ceramic or lacquer detail and one textile detail on the admitted exhibition route.
For each, record its material or medium and one visible pattern, surface or shape. Use the label if identifying the material requires it.
Outside sensitive rooms, assemble the three observations into a short material list.

q.s: Make a short response after two urban-history themes.
st: Observe the available Constructing the City theme and one detail about the city’s form.
Observe the available A Century of Chiang Mai theme and one detail about transport, trade or another documented change.
After leaving the galleries, write four original lines or draw two small frames connecting the two details. Add one sentence explaining the connection.

q.s: Create after observing Wat Phan Tao’s hall front.
st: Observe the peacock emblem and its surrounding carving from a permitted ordinary visitor position.
Choose one curve or repeated shape that you can actually see.
Outside the sensitive temple room and walking line, make a new small sketch or four original written lines using that shape in a different arrangement. Add one sentence about the change.
